question: Does lowering the shared optimization budget improve the absolute validation performance or useful bands benefit while leaving more training headroom?
comparison: 8 fresh runs:4 models × baseline/bands,fold0seed0; identical recipes and fixed prior band targets.
selection_policy: Report validation floor50%, absolute validation Dice, bands delta, training Dice and gaps. Do not treat a bigger delta caused only by baseline undertraining as a better model.
caveat: Earlier3x checkpoints use the longer LR horizon; they do not predict exact fresh2x results.
